text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Daddy, what should we do?! I forgot to buy a limited edition bag! I went out all the way!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: That's right, that's the brand you like! It's popular, so it'll sell out soon, right? Geez~ Saiacoo!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? You're going to go buy it? Seriously? Right now? Ahh, genius~!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Oh, hey, that means... Do you want me to go get the house?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Can you bring it to me?? Eh, today?! Yaaaan, thanks! Daddy, I love you! ♡
